fundamental.headline: Mixed business, and expensive
fundamental.health: Sales up 12% over the last year, it keeps 6 cents of every sales dollar as free cash, it has more cash than debt.
fundamental.price_text: You're paying more than usual: its price vs sales is higher than 88% of the last 5 years. However, it looks cheaper than similar companies once growth is considered.
drivers: Sales growth is speeding up compared with six months ago.
Profit margins are widening: it keeps more of each sale than a year ago.
news: Recent guidance update is bad news for the company; the stock already reacted, so much of it is likely in the price, and it could matter for months.

timing.label: No rush

news_impact: How it could affect things: Touches sales growth and valuation. Guidance resets the revenue and profit path investors price in.

Magnitude: insufficient history of similar events for this company.

deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 25% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.8% = 10-year Treasury 4.8% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 12% last year; 4%/yr over 3 years — the market expects faster growth than the company has recently delivered.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: 1% (3 years ago -2%, rising) — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $1 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity -10% (3 years ago -2%). (Tax rate estimated at 21%: effective rate not reported.)

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 4%/yr over 3 years and -5%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 3% vs a 5-year range of -23–26% (median -3%): in the middle of its range.
deeper.margin_position: in the middle of its range

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: No buybacks or dividends reported over the last 12 months. Share count up 17.1% from a year ago (stock pay outpacing buybacks — dilution).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $1.79, down 12% in 90 days (down 14% in the last 30); 12 analysts raised, 8 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $1.49, down 2% in 90 days (down 2% in the last 30); 3 analysts raised, 7 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By segment, latest quarter vs a year earlier: Total Intel Products 93% of sales, up 22%; All Other 4% of sales, down 30%. Source: 10-Q XBRL.

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +126% vs a year ago · $-2.27 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 126% vs sales 21%: profits are outgrowing sales, so margins are widening.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: Beat forecasts 5 quarters running, but the beats are shrinking (1193% → 579%): the bar is getting harder to clear.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.read: Sales up 21% from a year ago and speeding up (from 7% two quarters ago): demand is strengthening.
tiles.explain: Growth of quarterly sales (revenue) compared with the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $3 of operating profit, up from $-4 a year ago: profitability is improving.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It kept $3.8B of cash after investment over 12 months.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: P/E isn't meaningful: earnings over the last 12 months were negative or missing.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share: how many years of today's profit you pay for.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Jan 28; analysts expect EPS of $0.25, up 66% from a year ago. It usually moves about 12% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.

tiles.title: Forecast changes
tiles.read: Next year's EPS forecast is down 12% in 90 days (12 raised, 8 cut lately): forecasts are falling.
tiles.explain: How the average analyst forecast for next year's earnings per share changed (Yahoo, unofficial).
